BUILT FOR TRUST / 03

Trust is built on what you can verify.

AUVEN signs agent passports and activity checkpoints with ML-DSA-65. Exported records can be checked independently, so teams can verify exactly what was signed.

Controls apply to supported actions routed through the gateway. Mainnet commitments require a configured signer; this visual is an illustrative product flow.
